Description: Long-format table of all released coloring trials. Onsets are taken from the fNIRS trial-start marker; duration is the fixed 20-s coloring period; completion_time_s is the behavioral completion time.

onset.Description: Trial onset relative to fNIRS recording start.

completion_time_s.Description: Behavioral completion time within the 20-s coloring period.

Levels.leader-follower: A controlled position and B controlled force.
Levels.egalitarian: A controlled X-axis position/force and B controlled Y-axis position/force.
